items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: I’ve had several of my cousins show up and they love it when I talk about our grandparents — Big Mama and Pa-Pa

ctx.x: Did your parents or grandparents and cousins — have they had a chance to see you in your concerts?

Yeah a few have. Yeah. Down through the years I’ve had several of my cousins show up and they love it when I talk about our grandparents — Big Mama and Pa-Pa and growing up on the river. And once in a while I’ll mention their name — they get a kick out of that. And I feel like it’s a way to keep our kin folks alive, you know our kin folks very much in the music and for me it’s huge because it gives me a chance to, first of all, I get to bring them with me. I get to bring my Big Mama and my Pa-pa with me, and my…

the song, true to the energy in the room, and just be one with that. I could — it doesn’t even have anything to do with singing in English, which I’ve proven — many of us in the music industry when we sing anywhere where people don’t even speak English, it’s just something about making contact with what’s going on in the room, and that’s everything.
